Browser **getter assertions** do two jobs at once: they read a value and assert
it, and they **auto-wait** — retrying until the assertion holds or the timeout
passes. `Get Text    data-testid=result-count    ==    4` waits for the count to
become 4. You almost never need `Sleep`.

`Get Element Count` asserts how many elements match a locator — handy for
counting cards, rows, or results.

## Task 1 — Assert the catalog contents with getter assertions

**Goal:** create `checks/catalog.robot` with a small `Sign In` helper keyword,
then a test that asserts the catalog reports four products and shows four cards.

Here is the same shape using a helper and getter assertions, as a different
user. Adapt it to `primary_user` and assert the `result-count`.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Keywords ***
Sign In
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    reviewer_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit

*** Test Cases ***
Catalog Renders Its Cards
    Sign In
    Get Text    data-testid=catalog-title    contains    Catalog
    Get Element Count    data-testid=catalog-card    ==    4
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the test uses `Get Element Count`.

<!-- hint -->
Put the four sign-in steps into a `Sign In` keyword under `*** Keywords ***`, then
call it as the first line of the test.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Assert the reported count and the card count:
`Get Text    data-testid=result-count    ==    4` and
`Get Element Count    data-testid=catalog-card    ==    4`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Keywords ***
Sign In
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit

*** Test Cases ***
Catalog Shows Four Products
    Sign In
    Get Text    data-testid=result-count    ==    4
    Get Element Count    data-testid=catalog-card    ==    4
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the test `Catalog Shows Four Products` passes.
